title: Table 5-5: Description for status of indicator light of inverter (INV)
markdown:
| Green and on       | Power of load is supplied by inverter               |
|--------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| Green and flashing | Inverter starts or is in stand-by status (ECO mode) |
| Red and on         | Inverter is in fault                                |
| Off                | Inverter cannot work                                |
